result.summary: The landlord replied "Yes please arrange an engineer, thank you" (event 008) to our request to send an appliance engineer to inspect the washing machine. That is a clear yes, so I recorded the approval and moved the ticket to provider selection. I also let the landlord and tenant know where things stand. The approval only covers the inspection. Any repair cost will go back to the landlord for approval.
result.situation: Tenant Noah reported that the washing machine at Flat 20, 120 Alder Lane doesn't heat water on 60°C+ cycles. The rest of the hot water supply works. This is routine. Event 004 asked landlord Mercer by email whether we could send an engineer, approval 2 was pending, and the landlord said yes in event 008. Event 007 asked whether the landlord needs a response. The answer is only a short acknowledgement, which I've sent. No contractor is assigned yet.
